keySentence: Colin thought he was sick but the garden changed him.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Mary told Colin about the garden. Colin was scared to go outside. But Mary encouraged him. Colin thought he was sick but the garden changed him.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Mary whispered to Colin about the beautiful secret garden. Colin could not believe his mother's garden still existed. He was terrified of going outside for the very first time. Colin thought he was sick but the garden changed him completely. Mary and Dickon pushed his wheelchair through the hidden door. When Colin saw the garden, tears of wonder filled his eyes.
